countability_resolution_rule: All three canonical countability authorities must agree. A stale or contradictory task-registry activation_status field has zero authority and must not make a countable cohort non-countable or vice versa.
task_registry_mutation_policy: The frozen registry is not rewritten merely to refresh current cohort eligibility. Current eligibility is resolved from canonical state/control/assignment; schedule-registry changes require their own separately authorised lifecycle.
fail_closed_rule: If canonical state, active control and active assignment disagree on countability, validation fails and no calibration credit is allowed.
